Method of Attack: Android RAT (remote access tool) targeting e-banking users
Stealing credentials via fraudulent bank customer support agents
Factory reset to wipe device as kill switch
Use of multiple communication channels including HTTP and WebSockets
Obfuscation by wrapping APK into encrypted JAR or DEX
Detection and deletion of antivirus tools before data exfiltration
Impacted Systems: e-banking users in Brazil, UK, Poland, Italy, Spain, China, Latin America
Attack Vector: Malicious Android app installation, often via APKs from shady websites
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted APK wrapped in JAR or DEX
Factory reset permission requested by app
Use of HTTP and WebSockets for C2 communication
Presence of keylogging and screen capture functions
